objective: The header gets an account menu on the user's avatar, and a new Account settings page holds email verification, the notifications setting and a password-protected deactivate.
acceptance_criteria: Start gate: POSTS-008 has merged to main. Test-first: commit the failing tests alone before the implementation; the implementation commit edits no test.

Your profile is gone from the primary nav. For an active account the header shows, after the nav and immediately before Sign out, a button with the user's Avatar, accessible name 'Account menu', opening a menu with exactly Profile, History and Account settings, which go to /profile/<own id>, /history and /settings. It uses the existing Menu component, with its keyboard behaviour unchanged.

Anonymous, no-profile and deactivated sessions show no account menu, and their Sign in or Sign out behave as today. The button's target is at least 44 by 44 CSS px, at 320, 360 and 1280 px wide, and the header does not overflow at 320 px.
The profile page no longer has an Account section or Deactivate account. Its summary, date of birth and settings form are unchanged.
/settings, behind RequireAuth, has the heading Account settings and, in this order, Verify this account, Notifications and Deactivate account.

VerifiedIdentity gains auth_time from the verified token, required in CognitoTokenVerifier. DELETE /users/me answers 403 {"detail": "recent_auth_required"} unless auth_time is within the last 5 minutes, with the check on the server. A repeat by an already deactivated caller within that time stays the 204 no-op, and POST /users/me/recover has no such requirement.

AuthService gains reauthenticate(password), which signs in again with the session's own email through the existing SRP flow and replaces the session, so the next ID token has a fresh auth_time. A wrong password raises the existing NotAuthorized error, and the current session stays intact. Only CognitoAuthService imports the SDK, and sdk-isolation.test.ts still passes.

Deactivate account opens ConfirmDialog with the existing text and a labelled, autocomplete='current-password' password input. Its Deactivate button is disabled until the input is not empty. Confirm re-authenticates, then calls DELETE /users/me. A wrong password stays in the dialog with a field error and makes no API call. The input is cleared on close and never logged, and no-secret-leak.test.tsx covers it.
On a too-many-attempts answer from Cognito the dialog says to wait and try later, and on success the app moves to the deactivated state exactly as it does today, focus included.

AuthService gains emailVerified(), read from the session's ID token, plus requestEmailVerification() and confirmEmailVerification(code), which use Cognito's attribute verification on the signed-in user.

An unverified account sees a primary button 'Verify this account'. Pressing it sends the code and shows a labelled code input with Confirm and Resend code. A right code refreshes the session and the page shows the verified state with no reload; a wrong or expired code is a field error.

A verified account sees a disabled button 'Verified' in --color-success with a check icon, not clickable or focusable as an action, its state readable by a screen reader and not given by colour alone.

Notifications is a checkbox labelled 'Notifications', checked and disabled. It makes no request of any kind, which a test proves by failing on any network call from the toggle, and the hint says 'On for every account for now'. EmailPreference and its route on /notifications are unchanged.

Browser rows at 320, 360 and 1280, light and dark, on localhost test accounts only, reported with measurements or NOT DONE: the menu by mouse and keyboard; Profile with no deactivate; verified state; deactivate with a wrong then right password, then recover; the toggle making no request; the header at 320 px. The unverified row needs an unverified account, so state which one or report NOT DONE.
frontend/src/test/bundle-budgets/USERS-006.ts declares, in the test commit, every output the unit changes. Entry growth is at most 2 KiB raw and 1 KiB gzip, and no output reaches 500,000 raw bytes.
No new dependency. amazon-cognito-identity-js stays the one SDK.
backend/openapi.json and frontend/src/api/schema.d.ts are regenerated. wiki/CodeContext/Modules/0x01-users.md and 0x08-frontend.md record the recent-auth rule, the menu and the page.
